facts.business: GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited is an infrastructure development company with interests in energy, transportation, and airport sectors, currently undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP).

auditor.name: T R Chadha & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion on consolidated financial statements due to significant uncertainties regarding going concern, multiple CIRP proceedings in subsidiaries, invoked guarantees, litigation, and inability to determine the impact of admitted claims; qualified opinion on internal financial controls over use of assumptions for asset impairments.

key_risks: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) admitted for the company and multiple subsidiaries
Significant doubt on going concern ability due to accumulated losses and liabilities exceeding assets
Invoked guarantees and commitments for GVK Coal Developers (Singapore) Pte Ltd amounting to USD 1132.45 million (Rs 10,71,913 lakhs)
England Court order crystallizing liability at USD 2.19 billion for GVK Coal lenders
Multiple litigations and arbitration proceedings across projects
Deconsolidation of major subsidiaries (GVK Energy, GVK Transportation) due to loss of control
Non-admission of resolution plans by Committee of Creditors, leading to asset-wise sale approach
Impairment of investments and loans in subsidiaries (Rs 84,120 lakhs and Rs 19,690 lakhs in GVK Energy)
Uncertainty in settlement of admitted claims (Rs 15,94,489 lakhs admitted vs Rs 21,79,248 lakhs claimed)
facts.related_party_note: Guarantees and commitments provided by GVKPIL and GVK Energy Limited on behalf of subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures; pledge of shares of group companies for securing loans of GVK Coal Developers (Singapore) Pte Ltd; corporate guarantees for GVK Power (Goindwal Sahib) Ltd and GVK Deolikota Expressway Private Limited; financial assistance undertakings for GVK Coal Developers.
